Truckload Privacy Policy

Effective November 4, 2026. This policy covers local records and optional driver accounts and cloud backups. Cloud controls are available only when the backend has been enabled.

Who operates Truckload

Truckload is provided by True Lavender. Privacy inquiries: antoinettewilliams@thetruelavender.online.

Information you choose to enter

Truckload lets you record routes, pickup and delivery details, load payments, fuel purchases, business costs, truck settings, trip history and uploaded rate confirmations. Some documents may contain personal or commercially sensitive information. Avoid including payment card numbers, passwords or unnecessary sensitive information.

Where records are stored

The current app saves trip information and settings in local application/browser storage and saved documents in local document storage (IndexedDB). These records are not automatically synchronized to a Truckload cloud account. Clearing storage or uninstalling the app may permanently remove them. You are responsible for retaining any exports and original documents you need.

Third-party technology and network requests

PDF reading and optical character recognition (OCR) are processed on your device, but the app may download OCR software, language files or PDF-related resources from third-party content delivery networks, including jsDelivr and Project Naptha. These providers may receive ordinary network metadata such as IP address and request details. Their handling of that information is governed by their own policies. This policy does not claim that no network information is ever shared.

Driver accounts and optional cloud backup

Account setup and password recovery use Supabase to send and verify an email code. After verification, choose a password for future email-and-password sign-ins. Supabase manages the password; Truckload does not store it in your local business records or backups. Supabase processes your email, account identifier, authentication records and connection metadata to provide this service. The app keeps its sign-in session in memory; restarting or reloading requires signing in again.

Only when you choose Save cloud backup and confirm the contents does Truckload upload your saved trips (including entered addresses, load details and costs), fuel records, truck settings, business budgets and expenses. Supabase hosts the database for True Lavender in the United States. One latest backup is retained per account until replaced or deleted. PDFs, photos, original spreadsheets, analytics preferences and sign-in codes are not included. Each driver can access only their own backup through the app. Authorized service administrators may access hosted records to operate the service.

Backup is manual, not continuous synchronization. Restoring is available only on a device with empty local records. Keep your original documents and independent exports. Cloud storage is protected by service encryption and account access controls; it is not end-to-end encrypted. Signing out does not erase device-local records, so use your own device.

There are no live Apple subscription purchases and no precise GPS access in this edition.

Support communications

If you submit the in-app support form, your email address, topic and message are stored in our private Supabase support inbox and sent to Web3Forms, a third-party form delivery service, for forwarding to our support email. Authorized administrators can review messages and provide updates visible when you sign in with the same email. This may include standard connection metadata such as your IP address. Web3Forms uses an access key associated with the receiving inbox. If you email support separately, your email provider and our receiving provider also process your message. Do not email passwords, full card numbers or unredacted sensitive documents. To request deletion of support correspondence, email the address above with the subject “Truckload data deletion request.” Some records may need to be retained where legally required.

Service diagnostics

The app reports email-code request failures and cloud-backup failures to help us operate the service. Reports contain only the failure category and timestamp, not your password, email, trip records or document contents. The service processes connection metadata and stores a daily-rotating hashed network identifier for abuse prevention. Diagnostic reports are best effort and may not arrive during an outage. Admin review actions and internal notes are recorded in a restricted activity history.

Optional analytics

With website analytics consent, Truckload also stores a random browser identifier for up to 30 days and a tab-session identifier locally to estimate visits. Supabase receives those identifiers and a server timestamp; visit records do not include your email, account ID, trip data, page URL or documents. The admin dashboard shows aggregate counts. Declining analytics stops future collection and clears these local identifiers. Earlier visit records are not automatically erased. Different browsers and identifier resets can count the same person more than once. This measurement is disabled in the native iPhone app.

Google analytics and Google Tag Manager are disabled in the native iPhone app, including when a previous consent choice was saved. On the website only, with your permission, Truckload loads Google Tag Manager (container GTM-NDGH4QWW). Tags configured within that container may collect page views, approximate geographic location inferred from IP address, referral sources, device/browser information and interactions. Google and configured tag providers may process identifiers, cookies and network metadata under their own policies. Truckload does not intentionally send trip details, uploaded documents, support form contents or precise GPS coordinates to analytics. Analytics is off until you choose Allow; you can change this choice under Account & privacy → Analytics preferences on the website. The container administrator must ensure that tags honor this consent and do not collect sensitive information.

Your choices and deletion

In Account & privacy, sign in and choose Request account deletion or Request backup removal. Submitting a request records it for review and does not immediately erase your account or backup. Our team will contact your verified email about processing, completion and any retention required by law. You can check request status in the app. Request records and review history are accessible only to the requesting driver and authorized administrators; internal audit history is restricted to the service.

For support correspondence, choose Request deletion of support information under Questions & feedback. This sends a request to our existing support inbox. Device records and documents are stored locally and cannot be remotely removed by an administrator; we will provide device-specific guidance if you request their removal. Exports and original files you keep elsewhere are separate. Removing the app or clearing browser storage may remove local records; preserve anything you need first.

Security

Truckload's device-local storage is not a substitute for encrypted backup or device security. Protect access to your device, use device-level security controls, and retain your own copies of important business records.

Changes to this policy

We will update this page when data practices or features change. The effective date above identifies this version. For questions or requests, contact antoinettewilliams@thetruelavender.online.
